note: Toby is now at home with his mum all evening, and also in the greenhouse at ten to nine: in two places at once.

patch.value: Friday 6pm to 8:30pm: at home working on his steam-train jigsaw. At 8:30 he told his mum he was going to bed early.
Friday 6pm to 10pm: at home at the kitchen table with his mum, working on his steam-train jigsaw. He did not leave the house all evening.
